rationale: Proliferation (dropout) CRISPR knockout screen in K562 cells with the genome-wide Brunello library, run as the benchmark arm of a minimal-library methods paper. Guides depleted from day 0 to day 24 mark essential genes. Two replicate cultures per timepoint give the full BARCS model (2 residual df). The library's NO_CURRENT_* non-targeting guides are nominally present but were cloned at near-zero depth in this deposit (about 90 total reads across all 1000 at day 0), so they drop out at min_total_count and cannot serve as a control null; essentiality is validated instead by the strong depletion of core-essential genes. The deposited per-sample files were merged into one count matrix (prepare.R); counts are unchanged.
